mapper.select:
SELECT m.* FROM mv m LEFT JOIN song filter_song ON filter_song.id = m.song_id AND filter_song.status = 1 AND filter_song.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN album filter_album ON filter_album.id = filter_song.album_id AND filter_album.status = 1 AND filter_album.deleted = 0
m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0
AND filter_album.id IS NOT NULL AND ( (filter_album.country IN ('中国', '中国大陆', 'CN', 'China', 'PRC') AND COALESCE(filter_album.province, '') NOT IN ('香港', '台湾', '澳门', '中国香港', '中国台湾', '中国澳门')) OR filter_album.region IN ('内地', '大陆', '中国大陆') )
AND filter_album.id IS NOT NULL AND ( filter_album.country IN ('香港', '台湾', '澳门', '中国香港', '中国台湾', '中国澳门', 'HK', 'TW', 'MO') OR filter_album.province IN ('香港', '台湾', '澳门', '中国香港', '中国台湾', '中国澳门') OR filter_album.region IN ('港台', '香港', '台湾', '澳门') )
AND filter_album.id IS NOT NULL AND ( filter_album.country IN ('美国', '英国', '法国', '德国', '加拿大', '意大利', '比利时', '西班牙', '葡萄牙', '荷兰', '爱尔兰', '瑞典', '挪威', '芬兰', '丹麦', '瑞士', '奥地利', '澳大利亚', '新西兰', 'US', 'USA', 'GB', 'UK', 'FR', 'DE', 'CA', 'IT', 'BE', 'ES', 'PT', 'NL', 'IE', 'SE', 'NO', 'FI', 'DK', 'CH', 'AT', 'AU', 'NZ') OR filter_album.region IN ('欧美', '欧洲', '北美', '大洋洲') )
AND filter_album.id IS NOT NULL AND (filter_album.country IN ('日本', 'JP', 'Japan') OR filter_album.region = '日本')
AND filter_album.id IS NOT NULL AND (filter_album.country IN ('韩国', 'KR', 'Korea', 'South Korea') OR filter_album.region = '韩国')
AND ( filter_song.id IS NULL OR filter_album.id IS NULL OR ( COALESCE(filter_album.country, '') NOT IN ('中国', '中国大陆', 'CN', 'China', 'PRC', '香港', '台湾', '澳门', '中国香港', '中国台湾', '中国澳门', 'HK', 'TW', 'MO', '美国', '英国', '法国', '德国', '加拿大', '意大利', '比利时', '西班牙', '葡萄牙', '荷兰', '爱尔兰', '瑞典', '挪威', '芬兰', '丹麦', '瑞士', '奥地利', '澳大利亚', '新西兰', 'US', 'USA', 'GB', 'UK', 'FR', 'DE', 'CA', 'IT', 'BE', 'ES', 'PT', 'NL', 'IE', 'SE', 'NO', 'FI', 'DK', 'CH', 'AT', 'AU', 'NZ', '日本', 'JP', 'Japan', '韩国', 'KR', 'Korea', 'South Korea') AND COALESCE(filter_album.region, '') NOT IN ('内地', '大陆', '中国大陆', '港台', '香港', '台湾', '澳门', '欧美', '欧洲', '北美', '大洋洲', '日本', '韩国') ) )
AND ( filter_song.id IS NULL OR CONCAT(COALESCE(filter_song.main_type, ''), ' ', COALESCE(filter_song.main_genre, '')) NOT REGEXP '流行|摇滚|说唱|嘻哈|电子|民谣|古风|爵士|纯音乐|乡村|金属|拉丁|古典|R&B|R＆B|节奏布鲁斯' )
AND CONCAT(COALESCE(filter_song.main_type, ''), ' ', COALESCE(filter_song.main_genre, '')) REGEXP '说唱|嘻哈|Hip[- ]?Hop|Rap'
AND CONCAT(COALESCE(filter_song.main_type, ''), ' ', COALESCE(filter_song.main_genre, '')) REGEXP 'R&B|R＆B|节奏布鲁斯'
AND ( filter_song.main_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{genre}, '%') OR filter_song.main_genre LIKE CONCAT('%', #{genre}, '%') )
AND ( m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR m.artist_names LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR m.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR filter_song.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR filter_album.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' )
AND (filter_song.id IS NULL OR COALESCE(filter_song.language, '') NOT IN ('zh', 'en', 'ja', 'ko', 'fr', 'es', 'de', 'it', 'th'))
AND filter_song.language = #{language}
AND YEAR(m.publish_date) = #{publishYear}
AND m.publish_date >= #{publishDateStart}
AND m.publish_date <= #{publishDateEnd}
AND m.duration >= #{minDuration}
AND m.duration <= #{maxDuration}
AND NULLIF(TRIM(m.url_2160p), '') IS NOT NULL
AND NULLIF(TRIM(m.url_1080p), '') IS NOT NULL
AND NULLIF(TRIM(m.url_720p), '') IS NOT NULL
AND NULLIF(TRIM(m.url_360p), '') IS NOT NULL
AND filter_song.id IS NOT NULL
AND filter_song.id IS NULL
AND LOWER(filter_album.type) IN ('single', 'singles', '单曲')
AND LOWER(filter_album.type) IN ('ep', '迷你专辑')
AND LOWER(filter_album.type) IN ('album', 'albums', '专辑')
AND LOWER(filter_album.type) IN ('live', '现场')
AND LOWER(filter_album.type) IN ('compilation', '合辑')
AND (filter_album.id IS NULL OR COALESCE(LOWER(filter_album.type), '') NOT IN ('single', 'singles', '单曲', 'ep', '迷你专辑', 'album', 'albums', '专辑', 'live', '现场', 'compilation', '合辑'))
ORDER BY m.publish_date DESC, m.update_time DESC, m.play_count DESC
ORDER BY m.play_count DESC, m.favorite_count DESC, m.update_time DESC
